name: CrowdStrike falcon-mcp
summary: CrowdStrike's MIT-licensed MCP server over the Falcon platform API, in maintenance mode since the vendor moved development to a hosted CrowdStrike MCP. Its Identity Protection module has one read tool, falcon_idp_investigate_entity (entity details, timelines, relationships, risk). Measured keyless 2026-11-10: the API's token and Identity Protection GraphQL endpoints answer 401; a tenant's API client is needed.
license: MIT (server); use needs a paid Falcon tenant

payments.notes: 2026-11-10: the pricing page's three self-serve bundles each list Identity Protection as a disabled item; identity security is an add-on beside Contact sales. No page read prices it or an API call; sales billing terms not read.

agentAccess.notes: Measured 2026-11-10 12:30Z, keyless: POST api.crowdstrike.com/oauth2/token and /identity-protection/combined/graphql/v1 both 401 (JSON error, trace_id, no WWW-Authenticate). The server takes a tenant-issued API client ID and secret. Server not run.

jobs.summary: Vendor's claim for Falcon Identity Protection: "analyze user behavior in context, uncover anomalies, and rapidly prioritize identity alerts". The MCP tool reads entities, timelines and risk; it detects nothing itself. Not measured.
